# The timeline column has no runnable example outside a scheduler

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

Engine 14 (cut on Nov 23, `ROADMAP.md`) adds four families on one time axis. Epic #20874 gives each of them "one example in the examples index". The scheduler and the Gantt chart have one (`examples/scheduler/basic`, `examples/gantt/basic`). The timeline family, which both are built on, has none: there is no `examples/timeline`, and no file under `examples/` imports from `src/timeline` (checked on `dev` at `b6e691cf`).

## The Problem

The timeline column is the piece a developer uses to put bars on a time axis into a grid they already have, without adopting a scheduler. Nobody can see that today. The only place that mounts the column on its own is a unit spec.

## The Architectural Reality

All paths are on `dev` at `b6e691cf`.

- `src/timeline/Column.mjs`: `Neo.timeline.Column`, a grid column (`type: 'timeline'`). The type is not in `Neo.grid.Container.columnTypes` (`src/grid/Container.mjs`), so a grid takes the column by module, not by type name.
- `test/playwright/unit/timeline/Column.spec.mjs:250-270` is the working shape: a plain `Neo.grid.Container` whose `columns` hold one ordinary column and `{module: TimelineColumn, ntype: 'timeline-header', dataField: 'timeline', text: 'Schedule', timeAxis: axis, eventStore}`.
- `src/timeline/TimeAxis.mjs`: `Neo.timeline.TimeAxis` with `start`, `end`, `tickUnit`, `tickStep`, `pxPerMinute`, `snapMinutes`, `nonWorkingDays`.
- `src/timeline/store/Events.mjs` and `src/timeline/model/Event.mjs`: the interval records, with `id`, `title`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `resourceId` among their fields. `resourceId` points at a row of the grid's store.
- An example is four files, as in `examples/scheduler/basic`: `app.mjs`, `index.html`, `neo-config.json`, `Viewport.mjs`.
- The examples index is `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`. The entries `gantt-basic` and `scheduler-basic` show the shape: `id`, `image`, `name`, `sourceUrl`, the four `urls`, `hiddenIn`, `family` (`"calendar"` for both), `component`, `feature`, `lookFor`.
- `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/TabContainerController.spec.mjs` pins the index: 75 entries (`:81`, `:276-289`) and the full order of ids (`:398`).
- `Design authority: n/a — calls no existing behavior wrong.`

## The Fix

1. `examples/timeline/basic`: a plain grid with one name column and one timeline column. Six to ten rows, each with one to three intervals inside one day, from an inline resource store and an inline `Neo.timeline.store.Events`.
2. One control that changes a record, for example a button that shifts the selected row's first interval by one hour through `record.set()`. The bar follows, because the view projects records.
3. One entry `timeline-basic` in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` next to the two existing ones, with a `feature` and a `lookFor` sentence that say what to try.
4. The index spec follows: the count becomes 76 and the id joins the ordered list.

Styling only if the example needs it, and then as SCSS in the same place the two sibling examples use.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `examples/timeline/basic/index.html` opens in development mode and shows a grid whose timeline column draws one bar per interval at the position of its dates. The pull request shows a screenshot.
- [ ] AC-2: the control changes a record and the bar moves without a reload. The pull request shows the frame before and after.
- [ ] AC-3: the example imports nothing from `src/scheduler` or `src/gantt`.
- [ ] AC-4: `examples.json` carries `timeline-basic`, and `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/TabContainerController.spec.mjs` passes with the count and the order updated.
- [ ] AC-5: CI is green, `check-examples-body-only` included.

## Out of Scope

Dragging or editing bars in the plain grid (the scheduler adds that); a guide page for the timeline (it follows once this example exists); any change under `src/`. If the column cannot be mounted as the spec mounts it, that is a finding for a ticket of its own, linked from the pull request, not something to patch here.

## Avoided Traps

- **Reaching for `Neo.scheduler.Container`.** The point is the column in an ordinary grid.
- **`type: 'timeline'` in the column config.** The grid does not know that type name; pass the module.
- **Rows as hand-mapped arrays.** Rows and intervals are records of two stores.

## Related

#20874 (parent; the family landed with #20876), #20498 (the standard for example overviews), the sibling guide issues for the scheduler and the Gantt chart filed the same hour.
